sections.heading: The family
sections.body:
*La famille*: *les parents* (the parents — also "relatives"), *le père* (father), *la mère* (mother), *le frère* (brother), *la sœur* (sister), *le fils* (son — the l is silent, the s is pronounced: /fis/), *la fille* (daughter; also "girl"), *le mari* (husband), *la femme* (wife; also "woman"), *les grands-parents*, *le grand-père*, *la grand-mère*, *l'oncle* (uncle), *la tante* (aunt), *le cousin*, *la cousine*, *l'enfant* (child).

Note: *femme* is pronounced /fam/, like "fam".

sections.heading: My, your, his, her: possessive adjectives
sections.body:
Possessives agree with the **thing owned**, not with the owner:

So *sa mère* means both "his mother" and "her mother" — *sa* agrees with *mère*, which is feminine.

Before a feminine word starting with a vowel, use *mon, ton, son* for the sound: *mon amie* (my friend — a woman), *son école*.

sections.heading: Asking about someone's family and news
sections.body:
- *Tu as des frères et sœurs ?* — Do you have brothers and sisters? → *J'ai un frère et deux sœurs.* / *Je suis fils unique* / *fille unique* (I'm an only child).
- *Vous êtes marié ?* / *mariée ?* — Are you married? → *Oui, je suis marié.* / *Non, je suis célibataire* (single).
- *Comment va ta mère ?* — How's your mother? → *Elle va bien, merci.*

examples: Voici ma famille.
Here's my family.
Mon père s'appelle Thomas et ma mère s'appelle Sophie.
My father is called Thomas and my mother Sophie.
J'ai un frère et deux sœurs.
I have one brother and two sisters.
Tu as des frères et sœurs ?
Do you have any brothers and sisters?
Ma sœur est mariée, son mari est italien.
My sister is married; her husband is Italian.
Hugo adore sa grand-mère.
Hugo loves his grandmother.
Ses enfants habitent à Lyon.
His children live in Lyon.
Nos parents sont à la retraite.
Our parents are retired.
Comment va ta mère ? — Elle va bien, merci.
How's your mother? — She's well, thanks.
Mon oncle et ma tante ont trois enfants.
My uncle and aunt have three children.
Je suis fille unique.
I'm an only child. (a girl)
Votre fils a quel âge ?
How old is your son?
Leurs cousins sont très sympas.
Their cousins are very nice.
